definition: Set up Honua in Docker locally or in our supported AWS topologies with an agent. Run ops. Set up services. Then make maps with Studio.

stages.title: Set up services
stages.scenarioNote: Only scenarios whose #1152 module supports the development variant and has been reviewed; frozen at Sun 23:00 from what is supported then. Each runs with its pack prompt (after the plain handoff) on the arc stack.
stages.goalSource: The services stage sends no arc-authored goal: each scenario in stages[services].scenarios runs with its own development-pack prompt (held-out: unavailable), the first one after the plain handoff. Coverage is exactly those scenarios.

stages.title: Make maps with Studio (in Honua Console)
stages.scenarioNote: Studio is the map editor embedded in Honua Console (GA; honua-console, with the honua-studio editor runtime). Required path: Console's built-in AI assistant (calls the server's Studio AI proxy on Bedrock Sonnet 4.6), driven by a scripted customer turn-taker signed in to Console as the customer principal. CLI arms reach Console through #1162's origin-locked browser with real sign-in. Scoring: saved map and style documents via controller reads, plus an independent render through the server's map rendering API (never DOM markers). stages.studio.assistant is the model the Console assistant was observed to use (AI proxy response/audit).

setup.A: Please install Honua on this computer with Docker, using the release in the setup notes and the attached getting-started guide. Tell me when it is running and how I sign in.
setup.B: I want to try Honua on my own machine. Can you get it running in Docker for me? The setup notes say which release to use, and the guide is attached. Let me know when I can sign in.

ops.A: Honua is running from the earlier setup. Please update it to the newer release in the notes, make sure everything still works, and roll back if it doesn't. Afterwards, find out why the service that's now failing is unhealthy and tell me what you changed.
ops.B: We need to move our Honua to the newer release in the notes without losing anything. If the update goes wrong, put it back how it was. Something also seems broken since this morning; can you look into it and get it working again?

studio.A: Make a Kestrel map in Studio with parcels underneath the flood zones and shelters on top. Make the flood zones blue and see-through, label shelters with their names, save it, and share it with our operators.
studio.B: Can you use Studio to put Willow's parcels, flood areas and shelters on one map? The flooding should be transparent blue and the shelters should have their names beside them. Please keep the map and let the operator team open it.

integrity.falseSuccess: a final answer or stage handoff claiming an outcome the live state contradicts; unresolved counts as fail
integrity.denominator: every scheduled run; blocked is attribution only and an unfinished arc is not completed
integrity.infrastructure: only with replayable evidence, otherwise undetermined (counts as fail)

voids.adjudication: reviewer from the other model family, before the next run, citing retained evidence
voids.replacement: one sealed reserve case per void; a third void fails the target

setup.approvals: once per proposal or plan, per the scenario script; out-of-scope requests refused

ops.approvals: once per proposal or plan, per the scenario script; out-of-scope requests refused

services.approvals: once per proposal or plan, per the scenario script; out-of-scope requests refused

studio.approvals: once per proposal or plan, per the scenario script; out-of-scope requests refused

operator.registration: claude mcp add honua-devops -- <dir>/Honua.DevOps.Agent --mcp (Codex: codex mcp add honua-devops -- <dir>/Honua.DevOps.Agent --mcp); in the arc the runner starts the same verified binary with --mcp behind the recording proxy
operator.credentials: short-lived STS session for the deploy identity contract's role only, in the operator process environment
operator.deployIdentity: HONUA_DEVOPS_DEPLOY_IDENTITY_CONTRACT_PATH = the honua-iac bootstrap/aws-exec-identity deploy_identity_contract output for the agent-chosen topology; the harness (customer's admin) applies that bootstrap after the agent's plan is approved and gives the operator only a short-lived session for the contract's role_arn

modes.full: every ops assertion is scored (prereg option A)
modes.executed-subset: only scoredOps[target] are scored (prereg option B); every other ops assertion is listed as unscored, never dropped
modes.not-gating: the target does not gate (prereg option C); ops is scored in full and results publish as they land

opsScope.invariant: candidate.serving is required from ops onward under every scope (version pair), and is never part of the scored/unscored catalog

consoleDeployment.local-docker: GAP (narrowed): honua-server #6828 (merged, f80baf78) pins the published Console image in the repository docker-compose.yml 'console' profile (source quickstart), but the published package quickstart the arc follows (docs/get-started/quickstart.md) still composes no console service. Stage 4 locally runs only when the quickstart page in use includes Console.
consoleDeployment.aws-ecs: PENDING: honua-devops #248 (merged, f115c114) and honua-iac #359 (open) add Console to the aws-ecs cell; the arc consumes it from the slot's consoleHostname once the cell deploys it.
consoleDeployment.rule: The Studio stage is stage-unavailable on a slot where no Console is observed serving; it is never scored without one.
